finding.title: Add profileId FK+CASCADE to 6 tables — tutored-mirror wipe currently orphans a mirrored child's data
finding.rule: profileId-in-PK Invariant / DB-6 (sync-able entity integrity, FK-cascade discipline)

evidence.quote: the learner_profiles row cascades to all mirrored rows in completions, ... curriculum_tracks, etc. No explicit child-row deletion is needed.
The FK `ON DELETE CASCADE` on every child table (completions, streak_events, learning_ledger, bookmarks, goals, etc.)
// `outbox` has no FK — without this its pending pushes for the deleted profile would survive.

finding.why: None of these 6 tables declare `.references(LearnerProfiles, #id, onDelete: KeyAction.cascade)` on their profileId column (every sibling table that IS correctly protected does). `ProfileRepositoryImpl.deleteProfile()` compensates by explicitly deleting from all 6 before removing the profile row — the team clearly knows about this gap. But `TutoredMirrorWipeService.wipeMirrorForGrant/wipeAllMirrors/wipeRevokedMirrors` (used on tutor grant revoke/resign, tutor sign-out, and the D18 revoke-reconcile path) does NOT replicate that compensation — it only calls `ProfileDao.deleteTutoredMirrorByGrantId`, a bare delete of the `learner_profiles` row, while its own top-of-file comment incorrectly asserts universal FK cascade covering `curriculum_tracks, etc.`. `tutored_pull_service.dart` (line 99, 'a point_configs FK violation') confirms these tables are actually populated for a live mirror. Net effect: when a tutoring relationship ends, the tutored child's mirrored curriculum_tracks/daily_plans/point_configs/profile_programs/study_day_configs rows silently persist on the tutor's device forever — a child-privacy data-retention failure that contradicts the code's own stated invariant, with no error or log to reveal it.
finding.recommendation: Either (a) add `.references(LearnerProfiles, #id, onDelete: KeyAction.cascade)` to profileId on all 6 tables (schema migration + schema export per DB-4), or (b) make `TutoredMirrorWipeService` explicitly delete from all 6 tables before removing the `learner_profiles` row, mirroring `ProfileRepositoryImpl.deleteProfile`'s existing pattern (no migration needed, lower risk, matches established precedent). Fix the false comment either way.
acceptance_criteria: New regression test: after wipeMirrorForGrant/wipeAllMirrors, querying curriculum_tracks/daily_plans/outbox/point_configs/profile_programs/study_day_configs WHERE profileId = <wiped id> returns 0 rows.
tutored_mirror_wipe_service.dart's header comment no longer claims universal FK cascade for tables that don't have it.

tool/schema_check.dart (or a new companion checker) flags any core/database/tables profileId column lacking a `.references(LearnerProfiles, ...)` FK, so a future new table can't silently reintroduce the gap.
